about: The days ahead (docs/engine.md, "The days ahead"; P8.2a): for each enrollment, the dates from today on, each with whether it is a reading day and the readings expected on it, supposing the reader reads what each day shows. A sample week is the same list for a plan just enrolled in. The plans are invented.
